\begin{restated}{Proposition}{prop:B3-logistic}{B3}{1}{local strong convexity of logistic regression}
Let $f_i(\theta)=\ell(y_ix_i^\top\theta)+\frac\lambda2\norm\theta^2$ as in Remark~\ref{rem:B3-R2}, $\lambda>0$, $R_x:=\max_i\norm{x_i}$, and $\psi(x):=\frac{1-e^{-x}}{x}$ for $x>0$, $\psi(0):=1$ ($\psi$ is decreasing on $[0,\infty)$, with values in $(0,1]$). Then for every $\theta\ne\etastar$,
\[
\muEff(\theta)\ \ge\ \lambda+\psi\big(R_x\norm{\theta-\etastar}\big)\big(\lmin(F''(\etastar))-\lambda\big)\ \ge\ \max\big\{\lambda,\ \psi\big(R_x\norm{\theta-\etastar}\big)\lmin(F''(\etastar))\big\},
\]
where $F''(\etastar)=\lambda I+\frac1n\sum_i\ell''(y_ix_i^\top\etastar)x_ix_i^\top\succeq\lambda I$. Consequently, on the ball $\Theta_r=\{\theta:\norm{\theta-\etastar}\le r\}$, the constant $\mu_{\Theta_r}$ of Proposition~\ref{prop:B3-region} satisfies
\[
\mu_{\Theta_r}\ge\lambda+\psi(R_xr)(\lmin(F''(\etastar))-\lambda)\ge\max\{\lambda,\psi(R_xr)\lmin(F''(\etastar))\};
\]
in particular $\mu_{\Theta_r}\ge\frac12(\lambda+\lmin(F''(\etastar)))\ge\max\{\lambda,\frac12\lmin(F''(\etastar))\}$ as soon as $R_xr\le\frac32$ (since $\psi(3/2)\approx0.518$).
\end{restated}
